name: Molemen
description: Molemen were a species of diminutive, naturally blind humanoids with white skin. In 22 BBY, when the Jedi Obi-Wan Kenobi and Anakin Skywalker confronted Zam Wesell in the Outlander Club on Coruscant, three molemen were being escorted by a tour guide to the club's Digisee gaming floor.
